title: Heat Pump Services in San Antonio, TX
desc: Contact Rosenberg Plumbing & Air today for heat pump installation in the San Antonio area. We have been serving the area since 2003.

blocks.text: Whether you are looking to upgrade your home’s efficiency or need a quick fix during a cold snap, Rosenberg Plumbing & Air provides comprehensive heat pump services to keep your home comfortable year-round. As a versatile solution for both heating and cooling, a well-maintained heat pump is one of the most cost-effective investments a homeowner can make.
Expert Heat Pump Services in San Antonio

Since 1986, Rosenberg Plumbing & Air has been the trusted name for indoor comfort in the San Antonio area. Our NATE-certified technicians are experts in the latest heat pump technology, ensuring that your system—whether air-source, ground-source, or a hybrid—operates at peak performance.
If your current system is over 10–15 years old or requiring frequent repairs, it may be time for a replacement. We help you select the right unit for your home’s size and your budget.

items: Energy Efficiency: Modern heat pumps offer significantly higher SEER and HSPF ratings than older models, lowering your monthly utility bills.
Dual Functionality: Enjoy a single system that handles both summer cooling and winter heating.
Professional Sizing: Our team performs detailed load calculations to ensure your new unit is perfectly sized for your living space.

blocks.text: A malfunctioning heat pump can lead to uneven temperatures or high energy spikes. We offer 24/7 emergency repair services to ensure you’re never left in the cold. Common issues we resolve include:

items: Refrigerant leaks and low levels
Faulty reversing valves (which allow the unit to switch between heating and cooling)
Electrical component failures or thermostat miscalibrations
Frozen outdoor coils or clogged drainage lines

blocks.text: Routine maintenance is the best way to extend the lifespan of your equipment and keep your manufacturer’s warranty valid. Through our Comfort Club Membership, we provide precision tune-ups that include:

items: Cleaning condenser and evaporator coils to maintain airflow.
Inspecting and tightening all electrical connections.
Checking refrigerant pressures and temperatures.
Lubricating moving parts to prevent wear and tear.
Clearing condensate drain lines to prevent water damage.
